statements.text:
As AI rapidly evolves, our laws must catch up — that includes preserving the dignity of artists and the authenticity of their work.

Our TRAIN Act would grant creators access to AI training model records to determine if their copyrighted work was used without permission. https://t.co/dRWrMqYNbI

As AI rapidly evolves and becomes more present in our lives, our laws must catch up — that includes preserving the dignity of artists and the authenticity of their work. There is no path for creators to know if their work has been used — without their permission and without compensation — to train AI models. The TRAIN Act would grant artists access to such AI records.

Last year, our Take It Down Act became law to protect Americans online.
 
As reports find X's Grok chatbot generated heinous and illegal images, the Department of Justice must follow the law. https://t.co/3GXYmuvQs2

The use of AI is only growing, and Congress must catch up with common sense, common ground regulations. By granting every person a clear, federal right to control digital replicas of their own voice and likeness, the NO FAKES Act will empower victims of deep fakes; defend against sexually explicit deepfakes; and safeguard human creativity and artistic expression. We must support technological innovation while preserving the privacy, safety, and dignity of all Americans.

statements.text:
AI deepfakes are stealing our voices, faces, and identities.
 
The technology is moving fast, but the law hasn't caught up.
 
That’s why Congresswoman Salazar and I introduced the NO FAKES Act — to put the power over your voice and likeness back where it belongs — with you.

The President says we should sit still on AI.
 
Americans and the industry know better.
 
We have the proposals. We have the support across the aisle. We must pass guardrails on AI before it's too late. https://t.co/0qTkYgVI1q

Government must meet this moment. AI is advancing at extraordinary speed. It has enormous potential, but it also raises serious questions about privacy, discrimination, security, jobs, and the concentration of power in the hands of a few companies.
